summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with a neutral 'Despair' entity (the 'color'/despair creature) on g4. Each round it walks one step toward the nearest piece (either colour) that is currently being attacked by an enemy piece, and removes that piece when it reaches it; ties between equidistant targets are random. The narrator loses his queen early but later the entity captures the black king after the king steps onto a square his rook attacks, winning the game.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600).
Neutral Despair entity starts on g4; moves one king-step per round after Black's move.
Target = the nearest piece (by king-move count) that is currently attacked by an enemy piece; ties broken randomly (50/50).
When it reaches the target square it removes that piece; it may also step back toward a different target as attacks change.
If no piece is attacked it does not hunt (wanders/stays) [inferred].
Kings count: if a king is attacked and the entity reaches it, the king is removed and that side loses.
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or have the entity remove the black king (how the video ended).
